capabilities: Record meetings and transcribe them with speaker labels and clickable timestamps
Generate summaries, decisions, and dated action items linked to owners
Capture web pages, videos, social posts, bills, and existing transcripts as notes
Answer questions about the vault with links back to source notes
Import calendars, draft follow-ups, and export recaps as Word documents or email
disambiguation: Not a general chatbot sidebar; its core job is turning recordings, pages, and documents into structured meeting notes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Paid provider keys are optional end to end: self-hosted WhisperX and Ollama keep the whole pipeline local and free. Includes a detailed account of what the community catalog security scan reports and why.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record meetings, transcribe speech with speaker labels, or generate summaries and action items from audio and web content.

relations.evidence: With Power Explorer installed, Ask uses its vault-wide index instead
A standalone Model Context Protocol server in mcp/ exposes this vault to Claude Desktop and Claude Code

requires.name: yt-dlp, WhisperX server, or a local LLM server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp)
Microsoft 365 via your own Azure app registration

summary: Meeting recorder and AI assistant that turns audio, video, web pages, and documents into notes with transcripts, action items, and vault Q&A.
